## Studied delivery model

Students received 50-minute sessions each school day, combining remedial and grade-level mathematics with frequent assessments. Paraprofessional tutors worked with two students; tutoring supplemented regular math classes. Its timetable displaced different courses in the two trials.

## Provider history and scope

The article calls the developer Saga Education and explains its origins in Match Education, its spin-off as SAGA Innovations, and its 2019 name change. The provider link identifies that organization and program lineage; it does not assert that the current legal organization operated independently throughout the first trial. This record represents the studied Chicago model, not every later Saga service or technology-assisted variant.
